links.outcome: Effect of knowledge-graph grounding conditions versus ungrounded LLM on causal, evidence, unsupported-claim, and intervention accuracy metrics
links.effect: Integrated grounding (C4) had best causal edge F1 0.838, adverse-effect F1 0.833, evidence accuracy 0.738, unsupported claim rate 0.114; ungrounded C1 had highest raw intervention accuracy 0.948 but no measurable grounding.
links.quote: The metric panel discriminates conditions along interpretable, non-redundant axes: C4 obtains the strongest causal edge F1 (0.838), adverse-effect F1 (0.833), evidence accuracy (0.738), and unsupported claim rate (0.114), while C1 obtains the highest raw intervention accuracy (0.948) with no measurable causal or evidential grounding.
